title: ampelocissus grantii
intro: Ampelocissus grantii, commonly known as the East African grapevine, is a species of flowering plant in the grape family (Vitaceae). It is used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, with its leaves and stems providing health benefits such as treating fever, diarrhea, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Ampelocissus grantii include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its potential in treating various diseases. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
